popup.$description: Instant when the reader prefers reduced motion. Use for the scale or slide of popups as they open and close, such as dropdowns, menus, popovers, tooltips, and modals. Fade their opacity with `transition.fade`.

disclosure.$description: Instant when the reader prefers reduced motion. Use when content expands or collapses, for chevrons that turn with it, and for menu panels that slide in and out.

indicator.$description: Instant when the reader prefers reduced motion. Use when a selection indicator answering a click moves to a new position or size, such as a tab indicator or a switch thumb.

press.$description: Instant when the reader prefers reduced motion. Use for a control growing as it is pressed (`dimension.travel.press`), such as a button or a field under a finger. Settle it back with `movement.release`.

release.$description: Instant when the reader prefers reduced motion. Use for a pressed control settling back to its size when it is let go, without overshooting. Grow it with `movement.press`.

scroll.$description: Instant when the reader prefers reduced motion. Use for content moving inside its scroll area on its own, such as a list following its end while text streams in, an item added at the end gliding into view, or content that arrived out of view sliding in. A component following a moving target can run it as a critically damped spring that is most of the way there (about 92%) after the duration.

navigation.$description: Instant when the reader prefers reduced motion. Use for moving between places in an interface, such as a page sliding in, a view swiped aside and snapping back, or a tab indicator following the view in use, and for panes growing or shrinking as one comes or goes.

indicator.$description: Instant when the reader prefers reduced motion. Component token for the table of contents indicator following the reading position. Overshoots slightly before it settles.

drawer.$description: Instant when the reader prefers reduced motion. Component token for a drawer opening and closing, and snapping back after a swipe. Fade its backdrop with `transition.fade`.

navigationMenu.$description: Instant when the reader prefers reduced motion. Component token for the navigation menu popup moving and resizing between triggers, and for its entry scale.
